provenance.author: Vincent Russo
provenance.method: Galois descent over Z[i]: the four conjugates of the target under Gal(Q(zeta_16)/Q(i)) span a space of dimension min(4, m + 1); no search

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, one core; about 10 s for the certificate

llm.role: found the descent argument and wrote the certificate

notes: Settles chi(|sqrtT>^2) = 3 with the three-term witness. Galois descent: a stabilizer span containing |sqrtT>^2 contains its four conjugates (1, zeta^k)^2, k = 1, 5, 9, 13, four distinct points on the conic of product states, which span the three-dimensional symmetric subspace, so three terms are needed. Exact: the rank is computed in Q(zeta_16) and no margin stands under the bound. The numerical rank-2 exclusion over the 60 two-qubit states (closest approach 0.986 to the parallel threshold) agrees.
